brand.name: ALLUDE INDIA
brand.aesthetic: Premium luxury menswear, clean editorial, stark white background, no generic SaaS looks.

rules.wordmark: ALL CAPS, tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-widest, clean black lettering, no shadows.
rules.headings: Bold, strong, tracking-tight. Uppercase for category/section titles. NO INTER.
rules.body: Clean, readable, leading-relaxed. DO NOT center-align paragraphs.

colors.theme: Light mode exclusively. No dark mode.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows or none. No heavy drop-shadows. Flat architectural aesthetic preferred.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32. The layout MUST breathe.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers if needed, otherwise solid white backgrounds. For glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-b border-black/5.
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle, deliberate. Fade-ins, slow image scales on hover. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

layouts.hero: h-[90vh] to h-screen. Image hero, text overlay must be legible. If gradient used: bg-black/30 max. No heavy black blankets.
layouts.editorial_sections: Asymmetric grids. For example, a 12-col grid where image takes col-span-7 and text col-span-4 with a gap. Offset images.
layouts.product_grid: Minimalist grid. No card borders. Just image, Title below, Category, 'Explore'. Align text left.
layouts.stats: Massive typography (text-6xl or fluid clamp) for stats. Monotone, authoritative.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sharp, cardless or flat-bordered Shadcn components, dense data layout, high utility.

components.navigation: Header must have white or glass background. Bold uppercase links. Dropdown for Collections.
components.button: Sharp corners (rounded-none). px-8 py-4. High contrast (black bg, white text). Text uppercase, wide tracking.
components.footer: Premium white footer. py-24. Huge 'ALLUDE' typography. Minimal links.
components.forms: Use Shadcn forms but strip generic styles. Flat inputs, 1px border border-gray-300, rounded-none. Focus: border-black ring-0.

homepage: Brand Introduction ('CONTEMPORARY MENSWEAR. REFINED BY DESIGN.')
Design Innovation Excellence (Stat blocks: 2020 Est / 100% Quality / PAN INDIA / INNOVATION)
Our Strengths (5 items with line icons)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn components for forms, select, dialogs, etc., but customize them to remove generic SaaS rounded corners (make them rounded-none).
NEVER center-align paragraphs. Center alignment is only for hero text or specific headings.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform'.
Always use 'lucide-react' for minimal line icons.
All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-explore-button').
Build the Admin Dashboard in a separate route (e.g., /admin) with a dense, utility-focused layout.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
Only build Light theme. The 'dark' mode classes should not be utilized since ALLUDE is a white-background luxury aesthetic.
